title: The hidden language of psychopathy is not what scientists expected
caption:
Think you know how a psychopath speaks? A new study shows that personality traits like meanness and boldness don't create a single, recognizable communication style. Instead, they shape our stories in surprising ways.

Source: Sciencedaily - The hidden language of psychopathy is not what scientists expected
